LESSON: CARE FOR

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRON-
Topic 4.1: Care For

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Care For
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Where do we materials and items picking litter dispose rubbish?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Care For
2. give Kenyan examples of Care For
3. practise a safe skill for Care For

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Care For

Teach
• Observe Care For in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Care For (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Care For.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Care For.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Care For.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Care For.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Care For: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Where do we materials and items picking litter dispose rubbish?
2. Why do we clean environment how to dispose litter properly our environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Care For with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
